## What changes?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List relevant tests or manual checks. Include screenshots with fictional data for UI changes.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Relevant tests pass and documentation reflects the change.
- [ ] No credentials, personal configuration, real PR data, or private source is included.
- [ ] Runtime data, generated builds, and dependency directories are excluded.
- [ ] Changes preserve approval defaults, exact-commit publishing, and read-only review tools.
